scope: Launch recovery paths for payment, unlock, entitlement, media, notification, chat, creator profile, account, onboarding, refund/manual credit, resend, grant, freeze, and transaction-history scenarios.

adminCanInspectUserWalletLedger.evidence: Admin Users opens TransactionHistoryModal, which fetches /api/admin/user/:userId. The detail route returns transactions, purchaseTransactions, completedUnlockTransactions, commerce metrics, and support readiness.

adminCanInspectPurchaseUnlockRecords.evidence: Admin user detail API derives purchaseTransactions and completedUnlockTransactions from the transactions ledger and exposes the Action Ledger in the user detail page.

adminCanVerifyEntitlement.evidence: Admin Users shows unlockedContent counts and manages unlocked drops; protected content route verifies creator ownership or unlockedContent/unlockedContentTimestamps before streaming content.

adminCanSeeNotificationSendReadStatus.evidence: Admin Analytics/Debug expose notification funnel, dispatch outcomes, duplicate prevention, skips, read and clear counts. Per-recipient notification document inspection is not exposed as a dedicated support UI.

adminCanInspectChatConversationSafely.evidence: Support conversations are admin-inspectable in AdminSupportQueue. Creator chat routes enforce participant-only access; Admin user detail summarizes creator thread/message records for creator accounts but does not expose a full admin chat transcript viewer for arbitrary creator chats.

adminActionsAreAudited.evidence: Admin balance adjustments are guarded and include adjustedByUid, adjustedByEmail, adjustmentReason, adjustmentSource, and auditedServerSide. Admin entitlement grants create zero-amount unlock transactions with grantSource=admin but do not require a reason or explicit adjustedBy/admin UID metadata in the transaction extra.

manualCreditProtectedAndLogged.evidence: /api/admin/balance requires admin auth and trusted origin, requires a reason, updates balance in a transaction, and logs an admin_adjustment transaction with audit metadata.

manualGrantProtectedAndLogged.evidence: /api/admin/users POST requires admin auth and trusted origin, validates the Drop, updates unlockedContent in a transaction, and creates an admin-grant unlock transaction. Missing reason/admin identity metadata is documented as a follow-up hardening item.

missingActionsDocumented.evidence: This audit and docs mark PayPal refund, wallet-specific freeze, per-recipient notification resend, arbitrary creator chat transcript inspection, login provider recovery, and broken asset repair as external/manual actions when no product-safe admin action exists.

scenarios.title: User paid but Gum Drops did not appear
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin can open the user record, inspect balance, transaction ledger, failed purchase rows, purchase economics, and PayPal capture-derived transaction metadata. Server warnings for capture failures are recorded through route diagnostics.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Use Transaction History to verify whether a purchase_currency transaction and paymentLock exist. If PayPal confirms payment but no credit exists, use the Balance Adjustment modal to apply a manual credit with a reason. PayPal refund itself remains external to the app.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Manual GD credit must create an admin_adjustment transaction with adjustedByUid, adjustedByEmail, adjustmentReason, adjustmentSource, and auditedServerSide.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No one-click PayPal order lookup or refund status UI is present; operator must cross-check PayPal externally and app ledger internally.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Launch-safe: keep current manual credit path. Post-launch: add a read-only PayPal/order lookup panel that never credits balance without server confirmation.

scenarios.title: Gum Drops deducted but unlock failed
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin user detail shows unlock_content ledger rows and unlockedContent counts. The unlock route is transactional and returns alreadyUnlocked without double deduction, so true split-brain should be rare.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Verify the unlock transaction and user unlockedContent. If ledger shows a deduction but entitlement is missing, use Admin Users content management to grant the Drop manually. If entitlement exists, send the user back to the viewer/library path.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Manual entitlement grant should create an admin-grant unlock_content transaction; current metadata marks grantSource=admin but does not capture an operator reason.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: Admin entitlement grants do not require a reason and do not include explicit admin UID/email in transaction extra.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Do not change launch flow here. Before adding self-service recovery, harden the manual entitlement grant with required reason/admin identity metadata and a focused test.
scenarios.launchPriority: launch-critical recovery present with audit-field warning

scenarios.title: Unlock exists but viewer access is missing
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin can verify unlockedContent/unlockedContentTimestamps on user surfaces. /api/drops/content accepts either array membership or server-written timestamp as entitlement evidence.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Confirm entitlement and Drop media in Admin Users and Drop records. If entitlement exists and viewer still fails, treat it as viewer/content route issue and inspect route diagnostics or support thread evidence.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: If the admin must re-grant entitlement, the admin-grant unlock transaction is required.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No dedicated viewer-entitlement comparison panel exists; operator must compare user entitlement, Drop content fields, and content route errors manually.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Post-launch: add a read-only entitlement check card to Admin user detail that compares user entitlement, Drop content presence, and last viewer/content route result.

scenarios.title: Viewer asset is missing or broken
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin Drop/CMS and content media audit define public cover fallback and protected content proxy. Content route returns explicit not-found messages for missing content and index bounds.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Inspect the Drop record and media fields in Admin Drops/CMS, then replace or remove broken media through the CMS/upload workflow. If the protected URL host is not allowed, correct the stored media URL.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: CMS edits should remain admin-authenticated and trusted-origin guarded. No separate asset repair audit log was identified beyond Drop update metadata.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No one-click asset health report per Drop is exposed in Support; media repair is CMS/manual inspection.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Launch-safe: document CMS repair path. Post-launch: add a read-only asset health check to Drop admin detail before adding any automatic media rewrite.

scenarios.title: Notification was duplicated
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin Debug and Analytics expose duplicateCreatedPrevented, duplicatePushPrevented, duplicateBrowserDisplayPrevented, and notification dispatch outcomes. Server dispatch uses idempotency keys and browser tags.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Open Admin Debug notification/queue runtime evidence and inspect dispatch outcome for the Drop activation key/idempotency key. No destructive duplicate cleanup action is exposed.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Duplicate prevention is recorded in notification dispatch outcomes and funnel Debug metadata.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No per-recipient notification record viewer or duplicate cleanup button exists.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Do not delete notification rows during launch. Use Debug evidence to confirm duplicate prevention; add a read-only per-notification inspector post-launch if operators need it.

scenarios.title: Notification was missing
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin Debug/Analytics expose sent/opened/read/cleared counts and skip counts for permission denied, missing token, and preferences disabled. User detail shows whether push alerts are enabled.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Check user push preference, token/permission skip counts, and dispatch outcomes. Admin Drops can send a new Drop notification, but there is no safe per-recipient resend of a historical notification.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Admin-created notifications are guarded and deduped through notificationDispatchLocks; skip outcomes are recorded in dispatch diagnostics.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No per-recipient resend or send-status drilldown exists.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Launch-safe: document that missing notification recovery is diagnosis-first and any resend is a new admin notification, not a replay. Add recipient-level notification trace later.

scenarios.title: Chat message failed
scenarios.currentVisibility: Creator chat routes use participant-only guards and server diagnostics on send failures. Admin support queue is available for support conversations; creator chat records are summarized on creator user detail.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: For support chat, open Admin Support Queue and reply/update status. For creator chat, inspect creator/user detail summaries and route diagnostics; arbitrary full transcript recovery is not exposed to admins.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Paid creator chat messages create transaction and creator ledger accrual records when spend occurs. Support replies record senderRole and senderId.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No admin read-only full transcript viewer for creator chat failures.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Keep creator chat privacy boundary. Add a scoped support-only transcript inspector only after a privacy/legal decision and tests.

scenarios.title: Creator profile returns 404
scenarios.currentVisibility: Public creator route returns 404 when username is missing, the user is not a creator role, or status is not active. Admin Users can edit username; Admin user detail exposes creator record handoff for creators.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Open Admin Users, verify role/status/username, edit username if needed, reactivate if appropriate, and verify Drop creator assignment/public active status.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Username route records updatedBy on the user mutation. Status/role changes are admin guarded; separate audit-log rows were not identified.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No dedicated creator-profile resolver diagnostic explains which 404 gate failed.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Post-launch: add a read-only creator profile readiness checklist to Admin user detail. Avoid making inactive/banned creators public.

scenarios.title: User cannot log in
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin user detail exposes security summary and support channels. Banned/suspended account route informs users of blocked status. Firebase Auth provider-level recovery remains outside the app.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Search Admin Users by email/UID, inspect status/security events, reactivate if suspension was incorrect, and use support thread or external Firebase Auth console for provider issues.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Status changes are admin guarded; no separate support recovery audit log was identified for activate/suspend/ban actions.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No Firebase Auth provider diagnostics or status-change audit record is visible in-app.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Launch-safe: use Admin Users plus Firebase console. Post-launch: add audit rows for status changes and a read-only auth provider status card.

scenarios.title: Onboarding is stuck
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin user detail exposes creator onboarding canonical/history, support readiness, notification preference state, and behavioral/support signals. Onboarding UI records client issues for notification enable failures.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Inspect Admin user detail and support thread. For creator onboarding, use creator roster/admin handoff. User onboarding reset is not exposed as a product-safe admin action.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Any manual reset must be documented as manual DB intervention unless a protected endpoint exists.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No general onboarding reset/step repair action exists in Admin Users.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Document manual DB intervention for launch. Add a protected, audited onboarding reset only if launch support volume proves it is needed.

scenarios.title: Refund or manual credit scenario
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin can inspect purchase rows, PayPal order/capture metadata, and apply positive or negative GD adjustments with reason. Legal copy states Gum Drops are not refundable through the app.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Handle any cash refund externally in PayPal. Reflect app balance with Balance Adjustment only after policy/provider decision, recording the reason.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Every manual credit/debit must create an admin_adjustment transaction with adjustedBy metadata and reason.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No in-app PayPal refund endpoint or refund-status ledger type exists.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Keep refund as external provider operation for launch; add a refund ledger type only with policy, provider webhook/callback verification, and tests.

scenarios.title: Admin needs to resend a notification
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin Drops can create a new Drop notification. Notification API dedupes recent identical admin-created payloads and records dispatch diagnostics.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Send a new Drop notification from Admin Drops if appropriate. Do not replay historical rows manually; use Debug to understand why the original was skipped/missed.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Admin notification persistence includes dispatchFingerprint, idempotencyKey, dedupeKey, browserTag, and notificationDispatchLocks.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No explicit resend-existing-notification API exists, by design for launch dedupe safety.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Keep resend as new notification with fresh operator intent. Add per-recipient resend only after idempotency and audit semantics are designed.

scenarios.title: Admin needs to manually grant entitlement
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin Users has an unlocked Drops modal and server route to add/remove a Drop entitlement after validating the Drop id.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Open Admin Users, manage unlocked Drops, add the canonical Drop id, and verify the user record/library/viewer.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: The route creates a zero-amount unlock_content transaction with grantSource=admin. It should also capture admin UID/email and reason before this becomes a routine support workflow.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: Grant reason and admin identity are not required in entitlement-grant transaction metadata.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Treat as launch emergency recovery only. Next hardening pass should add required reason/admin UID fields and tests without changing entitlement semantics.
scenarios.launchPriority: launch-critical recovery present with audit gap

scenarios.title: Admin needs to freeze wallet or user
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin Users can suspend, ban, or reactivate a user. Creator/public routes check suspended/banned status in several creator operations. No wallet-specific freeze flag was identified.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Use suspend/ban/reactivate for account-level freeze. For wallet-only freeze, manual DB intervention would be required and should be treated as high risk.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Status changes should be audit logged; current admin status route is guarded but a separate immutable audit row was not identified.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No walletFreeze flag, wallet-only freeze UI, or immutable status-change audit log was identified.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Launch-safe: account-level suspend/ban only. Do not invent wallet freeze in this pass. Add audited wallet freeze as a separate security/economy feature if needed.

scenarios.title: Admin needs to inspect transaction history
scenarios.currentVisibility: Admin Users exposes TransactionHistoryModal and Admin user detail exposes the Action Ledger. API returns recent transactions with commerce metrics and verification metadata.
scenarios.adminActionAvailable: Open Admin Users, click transaction history, or open the full user record to inspect Action Ledger and support/security handoff.
scenarios.auditLogRequired: Inspection is read-only and admin guarded. Sensitive follow-up actions must use their own audit logs.
scenarios.missingUiApiDebugField: No issue found for launch-critical inspection.
scenarios.fixRecommendation: Keep current path. Add filters/export only post-launch if support volume requires it.
